title: perf(contacts): debounce the contact search
description: Typing in the contact search fired one request per keystroke. The search callback is now debounced by 300 ms, and the pending call is cancelled on unmount.
rationale: `import _ from 'lodash'` pulls the whole library into the bundle for one `debounce`; the repo already imports per method (`lodash/capitalize` in `client/lib/format.ts`).
